status: TEMPLATE: unsigned; not a registration. tools/prereg_from_template.py fills it; only the owner signs the filled prereg.
profile_title: daily marked-to-market portfolio return of a 1-5 session horizon book
procedure_note: P-HAC-L5 is the only candidate procedure of PF-1 whose reference cells pass size and power in the committed evidence; the bootstrap candidates have no operating domain and are not offered.

horizon_sessions.rule: integer holding horizon of the book in sessions, 1 to 5 inclusive

family.rule: list of K distinct hypothesis ids, named before the window opens

T_min.rule: integer usable sessions, at least 120 (the smallest validated T)

hurdle_bps.rule: registered hurdle on the mean daily net return, bps; never computed from the confirmation series

margin.rule: common margin, non-negative fraction (0.25 means the hurdle times 1.25)

min_units_per_session.rule: positive integer: usable units of the registered grid a session needs (framework section 2 (a))

origin.rule: 'real' for a registration; 'synthetic' only for a dry registration

dataset.rule: the dataset name in the data manifest

partition.rule: 'b' for a Track B test on iap-sealed-b, 'c' for a Track C confirmation on iap-sealed-c (U0 section 2); must equal data.partition

dataset_hash_id.rule: content hash of the sealed dataset as the data manifest records it; becomes the only entry of analysis_identity.data_versions

dataset_files.rule: optional: object file name -> sha256 of every file the service will serve; null to omit (the runner then checks only the dataset id)

image_digest.rule: the one line of deployment/docker/IMAGE_DIGEST at the bound commit (sha256:<64 hex>)

command.rule: list of strings: the registered analysis; the runner appends the dataset directory and the output directory and requires result.json

scripts.rule: repo-relative analysis scripts, committed at the bound commit

inputs.rule: further repo-relative files the analysis reads outside python/src/iap, configs/ and data/reference/ (may be empty)
